newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 soars after budget and U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 soars after budget and U.S. data.

text.p: UK shares leapt further into record territory on Thursday on expectations of a sharply higher opening in New York.
The latest U.S. employment report showed weaker-than-expected jobs growth in June, which supported the FOMC's decision this week to leave U.S. interest rates unchanged.
The FTSE 100 soared 112.2 points to 4,863.6 as the S&P index futures signalled a better start for U.S. stocks.

UK stocks had initially opened lower as investors interpreted Wednesday's budget to mean sharply higher interest rates were imminent. But the market proved resilient and later bounced on hopes that any dampening of inflationary pressures would ultimately be good news for stocks and bonds.
